policy: Public access and provenance PASS do not establish raw redistribution rights or privacy clearance. Each permitted source version needs a reviewed document ID, raw/body SHA256, redistribution=PERMITTED, privacy_review=CLEARED, rights_basis and reviewed_by. Acquisition artifacts cannot grant permission. No source is approved by this policy yet.
private_policy: Private storage separately requires private_archival=PERMITTED for exact raw/body SHA256, privacy_review=CLEARED, rights_basis and reviewed_by. Public redistribution approval does not imply private archival permission, and private permission does not permit public output. Acquisition artifacts cannot approve themselves. Current private approvals: zero.

source_separated_transient.rights_basis: Read already-public verified sources locally and retain only BCT-generated bounded entity facts, exact hashes, locations and own operational state. No source body, raw page, contextual quote or original-model raw response enters private/published checkpoint. This does not grant source archival or redistribution rights. Explicit restrictions, unsafe input and unknown provenance still block.
source_separated_transient.reviewed_by: Codex research-state schema review under user-approved source separation; not human legal clearance
